text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership possesses exceptional raw talent alongside an extraordinary intellect.
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right now, she has completely lost her motivation for racing... What a total waste.
How can I help her regain her drive?
choice_data_list: Was there something that made her lose interest...?
I wonder what made her lose interest in the first place...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The reason Ruler wants to slack off?
There's no grand mystery—she's simply sulking.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Did you know she attended a racing academy
before enrolling at Tracen Academy?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I heard she was exceptionally talented.
Yeah, I heard she was top of her class.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, she certainly showed remarkable promise.
...The school she attended happened to be managed by my mother—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She was a sharp thinker with exceptional running ability. She won race after race—
which is why she found it so enjoyable. ...However, the real world is rarely so forgiving, wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy is a gathering of individuals who are all "exceptional."
Her tactical playbooks won't work every single time here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
When she wins, she wins. But when her tactics fail to click, she suffers crushing defeats.
...She must not have found that very amusing. She began to pout, and eventually—
choice_data_list: She ended up like she is now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Precisely. That blockhead possesses a temperament
that makes maintaining motivation exceedingly difficult...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In short: "If it's a game she can win, she enjoys it and stays motivated; but if she can't win, she loses all interest entirely."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Conversely, could one look at it this way?
"As long as she can win, there is room for her to rediscover her motivation."
choice_data_list: (How can I help her start winning consistently...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What must be done for Rulership to consistently win and stay in high spirits—
Pondering this, I find myself on our daily online gaming call with her...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Want to play this today? A brand-new medieval simulation game.
Board gamers have been buzzing about its deep strategy and how fun it is.
choice_data_list: "Sounds great!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's a versus game themed around the Hundred Years' War.
Let's have you play as the defending French army, and I'll take the invading English army.

text_block_list.name: Prologue
text_block_list.text:
"The Hundred Years' War—a conflict spanning over a century, sparked by disputes
over the French succession and territorial claims. The battlefield: the realm of France—"
choice_data_list: (My scouts revealed their troop numbers...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's gather three times that amount. Summon the knightly orders and hire mercenary bands!
Above all, the battlefield is our home territory... We should have the upper hand in this battle.
choice_data_list: My formation is flawless! Victory is mine!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Now, I wonder about that?
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: True, you hold an overwhelming numerical advantage. But—is sheer headcount truly everything?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Crush them!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite possessing overwhelming troop numbers,
my forces are somehow gradually being driven into a corner...!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
An army isn't just about throwing numbers together.
What truly matters is the "combat readiness" of the units.
choice_data_list: Th-Then, I'll switch to siege defense...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh—let's see if you have enough provisions for that.
I've reduced the surrounding granaries to ashes. Your only hope is importing supplies from outside.
choice_data_list: Gah, then I'll request reinforcements...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no reinforcements are coming from anywhere.
I've already brought most of the influential neighboring lords over to my side, you see.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: You are now completely isolated and helpless—it's over.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Drill," "Supply," and "Diplomacy"!
Battles aren't waged on the front lines alone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an utterly brilliant maneuver. Compared to myself, who only
focused on the battlefield right in front of me, the sheer breadth of her vision was...—
choice_data_list: I lost... Not just in strength, but in grand scale...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Controlling the outcome not through momentary field tactics, but through overarching grand "strategy"—
Isn't that the greatest weapon she could possibly wield in racing?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The next day. I drafted a roadmap.
Its ultimate objective: "Victory for Rulership in the Debut Race."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, I intentionally left it half-finished. With this...
I intend to test Rulership's analytical capabilities!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "A roadmap? Hmph... Is this for your trainee horsegirl?"
choice_data_list: She's not my trainee, but I've been keeping an eye on her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without revealing that it's for Rulership,
I share the data. The goal is a 2,000m turf debutants' race.
choice_data_list: I'd love some advice on this from the strategist domi.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see. You want to polish it from a strategic perspective.
Well, that's my forte. Very well, I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
First off, this schedule is far too packed. I understand
time is limited, but her morale won't hold up like this. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Furthermore, standard practice dictates raising training intensity gradually.
Focus solely on stamina and burst power to avoid needless exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Have you considered her diet? If you want to build stamina while
promoting recovery, prioritize vitamin B1, iron, zinc, and protein.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Considering the competition, the course... and various other factors,
this level of preparation should ensure victory. —What do you think?
choice_data_list: —Incredible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A flawless analysis and an impeccable roadmap.
On top of that, diverse scenario projections paired with tailored strategies.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her talent is truly the real deal. With a conscious strategic approach,
she can "seize control of the race before it even begins."
choice_data_list: So, is there a way to fix her "late-break habit"?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hm? A late break...? Wait a second, this data............
————Hold on, don't tell me this is...
choice_data_list: "This roadmap is for you."
"This roadmap was made for you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the plan Rulership just perfected,
she's sure to claim a glorious victory in the upcoming debutants' race.
choice_data_list: "Want to give it a try together?"
"Won't you test it out with me?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
............No way.
Losing at some trash game is the last thing I ever want to do again...
choice_data_list: "But it's a guaranteed winning strategy, right?"
"Isn't it a completely foolproof strategy?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Of course it is! Because *I* was the one who flawlessly crafted it!
choice_data_list: "Then you can win. Let's give it a shot."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
......Fine, I'll test it out.
I have to prove my strategy is absolute perfection...!
